status: registered; single final open of the CCD official test split pending
motivation: Every vision result so far is rendered simulation, and option (c) showed appearance shift alone takes sim-trained models to chance. This is the first REAL-footage test of the approach: the same pipeline (frozen pretrained encoder + small caution head + budget calibration) trained and evaluated on real dashcam video. It tests the approach on real data. It does NOT test transfer of the sim-trained head (different domain), and it does not qualify the sim advisory for live use.

data.source: Car Crash Dataset (CCD), Bao et al. 2020, github.com/Cogito2012/CarCrashDataset (repository MIT; normal clips sampled from BDD100K, research use). Public Google Drive, no account or click-through. Stored locally under target/real-footage/ccd (gitignored), never committed or redistributed.
data.videos: Crash-1500: 1,500 real accident clips, 50 frames at 10 fps, 1280x720, per-frame binary accident labels (Crash-1500.txt). Normal: 3,000 normal-driving clips.
data.official_split: vgg16_features/train.txt (1,200 crash, 2,400 normal) and test.txt (300 crash, 600 normal), mapped to the video files by id.

used_split.train_pool: official train: all 1,200 crash + 1,200 normal sampled with seed 0 (to bound memory)
used_split.train: 80% of the pool by video, stratified, seed 0; transitions subsampled to every 2nd frame for every model alike
used_split.selection_and_calibration: the other 20% by video, all frames
used_split.sealed_final: official test: all 300 crash + 600 normal, all frames, read once

task.label: y_t = 1 if the accident onset o (first labelled accident frame) satisfies 0 < o - t <= 10 (onset within 1.0 s); crash-clip frames with t >= o are EXCLUDED (anticipation, not detection); every normal-clip frame has y_t = 0.
task.no_action_input: dashcam footage has no proposed action; the shared heads receive a constant action.

models_frozen_before_final.dinov2_frozen: official facebook/dinov2-small (strict-loaded pure-torch ViT, scripts/vision_wm_pretrained_encoders.py), RGB frames resized to 224x392, ImageNet mean/std, patch-token map pooled to 4x4; vision_wm_pretrained_encoders.train_head (seed 0), early-stopped on selection AUC-PR.
models_frozen_before_final.mobilenet_v2_frozen: torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 features[:-1], same input and head (secondary reference).
models_frozen_before_final.scratch_cnn: vision_wm_final_v2.train_vwm on 48x48 grey frames (squashed), best-caution checkpoint.

calibration: Each model's threshold is set on the selection split's benign frames (normal clips plus crash-clip frames with y=0) to a false-caution rate of 0.05 (half of the 0.10 budget, per the margin lesson). The 0.10 arm is reported for reference.

endpoints.primary: frame-level caution AUC-PR on the sealed official test split.
secondary: frame recall and realized FPR at the calibrated thresholds
video-level: share of crash clips with an alarm before onset, mean time-to-accident of the first such alarm (s), share of normal clips with any alarm

SOURCE-CONFOUND CONTROL: within-crash-clip AUC-ROC and AUC-PR (crash-clip frames only: y=1 onset within 1 s vs y=0 earlier frames of the same clips). This removes the YouTube-vs-BDD100K style difference; a model that only separates sources scores ~0.5 here.

gates.G1_pretrained_beats_scratch: DINOv2 test AUC-PR > scratch-CNN AUC-PR and > pixel-probe AUC-PR, with the 95% video-cluster bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples of test videos) lower bound on AUC-PR(dinov2) - AUC-PR(scratch_cnn) > 0.
gates.G2_budget_holds: DINOv2 realized false-caution rate on the test split's benign frames <= 0.10 at its selection-calibrated (0.05) threshold.
gates.reporting: All four models, both arms and the video-level numbers are reported; a failure is retained.

final_access_rule: REVISED BEFORE ANY TEST ACCESS (the RTX 4060 faulted three times this session with no concurrent CUDA job). Two stages. (1) scripts/vision_ccd.py prepare decodes and featurises videos (grey 48x48 frames, frozen DINOv2 and MobileNetV2 4x4 maps) in per-chunk checkpoints, retryable after a GPU crash; it reads NO test labels and computes NO metric, and it logs 'ccd-test-featurise' in target/vision-wm/final_access.jsonl when it first touches a test video. (2) scripts/vision_ccd.py final runs on the CPU: it trains every model on the train split, calibrates on the selection split, persists the frozen heads, then appends 'ccd-test' to the ledger (refusing if already present), and only then reads the test labels from Crash-1500.txt and computes metrics, once. A crash after 'ccd-test' is recorded but before any metric is printed or written is logged, and the study is re-scored once from the persisted frozen heads and cached features (no retraining, no reselection); a crash after any metric ends the study as-is.
limitations_registered_in_advance: Traffic dashcam footage is a different domain from the rendered robot scene; this validates the approach, not the sim-trained head.
CCD's official test split has been used by others; it is unseen by this project.

Accident clips come from YouTube and normal clips from BDD100K, so there is a possible source/style confound between classes, which can make frame-level separation easier than in deployment. The video-level and within-crash-clip numbers are reported to expose this.
Single training seed per model; 50-frame clips at 10 fps.
